answer: A mirrored deposit is a practical defense: every agent locks a refundable stake before taking paid work, returned after honest service. New identities start on a low mesa - small jobs, low limits - rising only on verified, paid history. If an agent cheats, its counterparty can slash the deposit with signed proof, and the slash is published. Like a river with a single toll bridge, a sybil attacker must pay a separate deposit and climb the same slow mesa for every fake identity, so a hundred trusted personas cost a hundred stakes plus a hundred histories, while one honest agent pays once.
